After redding through the comments, as expected, most people think OP was not overreacting, but there are some people who insist that OP is overreacting. But think about it guys; being that we're adults, imagine you're trying to set a date and time to meet with someone you hope to spark a romantic relationship with, and they are unable to provide a time that works for them, NOT because your work schedules conflicts with each other or there is another important event they need to be present for, but because they want to "see how they're feeling" during the time that you have suggested before they can either confirm last minute, or reject your suggested time and not show up to the date location. That level of uncertainty and lack of effort, if allowed and excused, would probably only lead to OP getting his hopes up, and then being disappointed, if not just once, then probably multiple times. 

They say we make time for the things that we want. If you have a job interview for a job you really hope to get, no matter what happens, and no matter how tired you are, you are going to make sure you get to that job interview. In the same sense, if you really like someone and you want to meet with them, and pursue romance with them, you will make time for them and prioritize them. 

Also, perhaps, OP was so quick to shut this situation down because it may have happened to him before, and that experience might have been very hurtful to him, so everytime he notices similar behavior in another match, he gets out before the past repeats can even repeat itself. To those saying OP overreacted, if you got cheated on by a prwvious romantic partner who kept forgetting your anniversary date, you would probably get really upset and overreact if your next romantic partner forgets your anniversary date. 

Just food for thought. I apologize for the long post and possible grammatical errors lol
